main_text.p: & Præpofit. מן · מאת & ל . Præter. שאל את־עבדיו [?] In-terrogaverat ferros fuos, Gen.44.19. חיים שאל ממך [?] Vi-tam petit à te, Psal.21.5. ושאל לו [?] Ut confulat illum, Num.27.21. וישאל בקציר [?] Et medicat in assate, Prov.20.4. ושאלך [?] Et rogaverit te, Jud.4.20. quod est ex terminatione Tzere : ושאלו לך לשלום [?] Interrogabunt te pacis, hoc est, valetudinis causa, 1.Sam.10.4. i.e. Pacifce te salutabunt : Vide & 1.Sam.25.v.5. 2.Sam.8.10. Chald. Præter. שאל לכל חרטום [?] Petiit ab ullo mago, Daniel 2.v.10. ארין שאלנא [?] Tunc interrogavimus, Esr.5.9. Futur. כל די ישאלנכין [?] Quicquid postulaverint, Esr.7.21. cum י epenthetico. Niph. נשאל [?] Exorari, Precibus obtinere: Præterit. cum Infinitiv. נשאל מעדי [?] Expetendo expetivit David à me, 1.Sam.20.28. id est, Obnixè petiit à me, & obtinuit. Similem formam vide in שלח [?]. נשאלתי מן המלך [?] Precibus obtinui à rege, Nehem.13.6. Pih. Præter. ישאלו [?] Et petant, id est, mendicent, Psal.109.10. Futur. שאול ישאל [?] Interrogando interrogabunt, 2.Sam. 20.v.18. Hiph. השאיל [?] Mutuavit, Commodato dedit petenti. Præter. והשאלתיהו ליהוה [?] Et mutuo eum Domino, 1.Sam.1.v.28. id est, Quem precario ab ipso acceperam, nunc rursus ipsi sisto & confecro, ut ipsius minister sit. Fut. וישאלום [?] Commodato dederunt ipsis petentibus, Exod.12.36.

שאול [?] c. Sepulchrum, Infernus. Sepulchrum autem sic à Petendo & Postulando dictum, quòd ore hiante & dilatato, Jesa.5.14. Habac.2.5. repleri expetat, unde & Infa-tiabile dictum, Prov.27.20. & 30.16. Significat autem in genere Locum corporum humanorum post mortem; unde communiter pro Sepulchro, interdum etiam pro Inferno ponitur. Dicitur etiam de Loco infimo, qui altissimo opponi-tur, Job.11.8. Mafcul. שאול עירום [?] Nudum est sepulchrum, Job.26.6. i.e. Abditissima & intima terra pars, juxta Aben

page.notes: Hebrew and Latin words in the first paragraph are copied from a small, heavily set page; Hebrew vowel points are faint and several Hebrew words are marked [?]. Doubtful Latin: "Et medicat in assate" (Prov. 20.4, probably a misprint for aestate, left as printed), "illum" after "ut confulat" (may read illi). "Vide" on the Sam. line is as printed. Text ends mid-sentence at "juxta Aben" and continues on the next page. No catchword is visible.
